data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the opening of 2018 were GBP 411.2m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 7.0m (1.7% of opening reserves), driven principally by adverse movements in Professional Lines and Energy and partially offset by favourable development in other classes. The 2017 hurricane catastrophes (Harvey, Irma, Maria) materially affected 2017 experience. No single gross prior-year release/strengthening figure is stated in the movement note, so the gross PYD above is derived from the published gross claims development table.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement amount was shown in a dedicated 'movement in prior years' note. A narrative net deterioration (GBP 3.3m) is stated (net of reinsurance). Therefore the gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development table (gross triangle) as a last-resort source. The triangle covers underwriting years 2011-2017; the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2016) were excluded from the PYD aggregation per standard methodology, and the computed total PYD is +GBP 7.037m (strengthening). The 2016 reinsurance-to-close into Syndicate 2008 and RITC activity may distort comparatives; users should treat the PYD derived from the triangle as an approximation.
